## Introduction

This repository maintains reference documentation for AutoJs4, cloned from hyb1996's AutoJs-Docs project. The original documentation project first appeared on `2017/08/21`; this repository uses the open-source Auto.js `4.1.0` documentation released by the original author on `2018/12/21` as its verification baseline.

The structure and applicable content of the open-source documentation are preserved, with Pro-only interfaces and descriptions removed and relevant corrections and supplements retained. The repository introduction and maintenance history are available in 10 languages; historical API text keeps its existing language.

Content is checked against historical documentation commit [0daee2a](https://github.com/GitCourser/AutoJs-Docs-original/tree/0daee2a17c54f531af33b7f98394508bc727b6d9) and the [original source preserved by AutoJs4](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs4/tree/8de11699b608be1c1f49f0f10e2e2826f8c77978/autojs/src/main). The original repository is unavailable, so the historical link uses a mirror retaining the original commit. Additional Canvas/UI interfaces were verified against the original source; Pro interfaces, Pro module-alias examples using `$`, and inapplicable Node.js `util` references have been removed.

[AutoJs4 application repository](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs4) / [Report a documentation issue](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs4-Documentation/issues).

## Original document archive

The [original AutoJs-Docs repository introduction](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs4-Documentation/blob/main/.upstream/README.md) retains the exact bytes of the first import and is not translated. The [original Auto.js 4.1.0 documentation](https://github.com/GitCourser/AutoJs-Docs-original/tree/0daee2a17c54f531af33b7f98394508bc727b6d9) is pinned to a historical commit, separate from this repository's subsequently corrected content. Historical links in the original introduction are unchanged.

## Related projects

[AutoJs4](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs4) is the behavioral baseline of [AutoJs6](http://project.autojs6.com): apart from a few specific cases, scripts that run correctly on AutoJs4 should produce exactly the same effects and results on AutoJs6.

[AutoJs4-Documentation](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs4-Documentation) preserves the applicable open-source Auto.js `4.1.0` documentation and serves as the reference baseline of [AutoJs6-Documentation](http://docs-project.autojs6.com). The application version `4.1.1 Alpha2` and documentation version `4.1.0` are distinct labels.

[AutoJs6-Plugin-AutoJs4-Runtime](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs6-Plugin-AutoJs4-Runtime) embeds the AutoJs4 engine modules `autojs`, `common`, and `automator` through a Git submodule and runs scripts in a separate process. "Run with AutoJs4" in the AutoJs6 file manager enables result comparisons without installing AutoJs4 separately.

[AutoJs6](http://project.autojs6.com) continues development from Auto.js. [AutoJs6-Documentation](http://docs-project.autojs6.com) supplies the shared content source for its [online documentation](https://docs.autojs6.com) and offline documentation plugin.

## Multilingual documentation

Edit the language JSON and templates in `.readme/` and `.changelog/`, then regenerate the documents. Do not edit generated Markdown directly. The root README uses Simplified Chinese. These commands require Python 3.10 or newer without extra Python packages; Windows can use `py` instead of `python`. `--check` validates languages, fields, historical versions and dates, punctuation, and generated files without writing. CI runs the same check.

```shell
python .python/generate_markdown.py
python .python/generate_markdown.py --check
python -m unittest discover -s .python/tests
```
